content.title: FuelCell Energy (FCEL) Narrows Quarterly Losses But Deeper Annual Deficit Raises Strategic Questions
content.summary: FuelCell Energy recently reported its fourth-quarter 2025 results, with revenue rising to US$55.02 million and the quarterly net loss shrinking to US$29.87 million compared with the prior year. For the full year, revenue climbed to US$158.16 million even as the annual net loss widened to US$187.90 million, highlighting growing scale alongside continued profitability pressures. Next, we’ll explore how FuelCell Energy’s improved quarterly loss per share shapes its existing investment narrative...
